# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Aug 3, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on Aug 3, 2026, focused on stabilizing CI/CD infrastructure, hardening agent security, and improving test reliability. Key achievements include pinning Bun runtimes across the repository, resolving fork-based evidence attachment issues, and implementing robust identity persistence for agent sandboxes.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

**CI/CD Infrastructure & Runtime Stability**
*   Standardized Bun runtime versions across all workflows, manifests, and templates to the canonical `1.3.14` to prevent build failures ([#17653](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17653), [#17615](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17615)).
*   Isolated fork quality jobs from runner state and pinned training smoke tests to ensure deterministic CI results ([#17523](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17523), [#17637](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17637)).
*   Improved evidence gate reliability by allowing fork-contributed text attachments and fixing fabrication marker matching ([#17601](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17601), [#17595](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17595)).

**Agent Runtime & Security Hardening**
*   Enhanced agent sandbox persistence by treating bind-mount overlays as authoritative snapshots, preventing settings regression ([#17648](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17648), [#17642](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17642)).
*   Strengthened cloud security by rejecting caller-authored system policies at the A2A boundary and separating API/callback failure propagation ([#17643](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17643), [#17498](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17498)).
*   Optimized prompt cache reuse for Cerebras to improve performance ([#17515](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17515)).

*   **Dependencies:** [#17654](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17654), [#17652](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17652).

## CLOSED ISSUES
*   **CI & Evidence Gate:** Resolved issues regarding fork evidence attachments, fabrication markers, and stale test matrix configurations ([#17600](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17600), [#17594](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17594), [#17614](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17614), [#17588](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17588)).
*   **Agent & App Reliability:** Addressed runner pruning, LifeOps signal retries, and missing test coverage for budget management ([#17566](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17566), [#17611](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17611), [#17597](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17597)).

## NEW ISSUES
*   **Internationalization:** The i18n source catalog has drifted significantly, and the strict checker is currently disconnected from CI ([#17605](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17605)).
*   **UI & Navigation:** Issues identified with malformed linked-account responses and settings view ignoring popstate navigation ([#17616](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17616), [#17618](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17618)).
*   **Infrastructure:** Benchmark Bridge workflow is failing to build workspace dependencies ([#17656](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17656)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES
*   **[#16263](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16263) Scheduled Android device e2e is failing:** Ongoing failure in the weekly host-backed Android suite. Recent comments indicate that while a shell-boundary repair is ready, publication is blocked by credential scope limitations on the GitHub integration.
*   **[#17043](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17043) Unauthenticated loopback API callers:** A P1 security defect where loopback callers lack bearer authentication. Work is in progress to consolidate these into a single authenticated helper.
*   **[#17044](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17044) Unify published Bun runtime:** A P0 build reliability issue. Recent activity confirms that the repository is moving toward a single source of truth for Bun versions, with active coordination to merge fixes into the main development branch.
